inputs.modified_text: A parent of three children in South Portland’s public schools is apologizing to the educators and staff facing another budget shortfall and cuts of more than 70 positions. This is not just a line in a budget: it means putting more pressure on school workers and risking support for students. Public education should not be forced to absorb the consequences of chronic underinvestment. The people who keep schools running—and the children who depend on them—deserve better.
